mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a First Quarter moon. If you are an early bird, look for the ISS at 5:39 AM as it rises over Mount Horeb and travels toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching high in the sky. The overnight low will be 34 degrees with no rain predicted.

City officials remind residents that a new zoning map and ordinance are in effect to help with property planning. Additionally, there are four official polling locations in Verona, so please check your assigned location at the My Vote Wisconsin website before heading out to vote.

Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers Market opens at the state capitol, and there is more live music over at Paddy Mac's.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers responded to a report of dangerous driving and confirmed no injuries occurred during the incident.
Today's flavor is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
